name: Client Lua loader: a client that announces hot patches gets the CoA interface pieces as SMSG 0x8F0
contract: A client with the hot-patch channel announces CMSG 0x8F1 (protocol 1, mode 2) after entering the world.
The loader's pieces then travel as SMSG 0x8F0 instead of SMSG_COA_PATCH_CHALLENGE_REQUIREMENT_TYPE (0x5BC):
the CoARotation button and the CoACompanions frame about five seconds after login, and both again after
the reloaded interface reports CMSG_SET_ACTIONBAR_TOGGLES (0x2BF). Expected: both pieces in 0x8F0 after
login and at least two more 0x8F0 packets after 0x2BF, while no 0x5BC carries either piece. The client's
execution of the patches is not exercised here.

steps.label: The client announces the hot-patch channel
DISCRIMINATING: the CoARotation button arrives as a hot patch
The CoACompanions frame arrives as a hot patch
The reloaded interface reports its action bars
A reload brings both pieces back as hot patches
Still no formatter carries the frame
